amends: evidence/rr-bounds.json and amendments 1 to 6: adds a validation scene, fixes a validation camera fault, adds model v5 and a recomputed selection; the verdict criteria, metrics, baselines, hyperparameters and test split are unchanged
written: 2026-10-15 04:40Z, before any frame of the new scene is rendered for the dataset and before any v5 training step. Declared: v4's test verdict (amendment 6) and the raw_hall diagnosis (evidence/rr-diag-raw-hall-2026-10-15.json, which used test data of that finished run) were seen before this amendment; nothing below is chosen from new test data, and test is read once, at the end.
coordinator_direction: 2026-10-15: build a raw_hall-like validation sequence (dense, indirectly lit interior) from our own assets, CPU-rendered, with the leakage check; amendment with the written prediction and bounds before any training step; train v5 with the brightness-matching term plus its shuffled-target control on the CPU (BelowNormal, checkpoints, watchdog, logon task); select on validation only; evaluate on test once; fix the hall_b camera fault.

validation_scene.name: cloister (src/tools/rr_scenes.cpp), new, assigned whole to validation
validation_scene.build: a closed interior 24 x 9 x 12, every surface tessellated at about 0.25 units (walls, floor, ceiling, 16 columns of 24 x 36 segments, nine ceiling ribs), four high windows in one long wall, eight small hanging lamps (emissive cubes, radiance (70, 66, 58)); materials by the seeded M3 family draw of the HW scenes. Written for this purpose; it shares no geometry or generator with raw-hall (owned_hall.cpp).
validation_scene.why: raw_hall's input energy is mostly emission from its lanterns and their bounces (an observation of the scene's inputs, not of any metric); the cloister is lamp-lit and indirect for the same reason, with its own lamps, colour and layout
validation_scene.sequence: path 7, 32 frames (the selection reads frames 0 to 31), 480 x 270, inputs by rr-render --input-only --cpu, references by rr-render --cpu at 4,096 spp in chunks of 1,024 (12 threads, BelowNormal)
validation_scene.leakage: rr_manifest.py guard on the dataset with the new sequence must pass, and its injected-test-frame control must fail

hall_b_fix.fault: frames 56 to 61 of hall_b_p7: the camera path passes inside closed geometry; the references are black (mean about 2e-6)
hall_b_fix.rule: on hall_b only: a camera whose 32 x 18, 4 spp path-traced probe receives no light at all steps back along its view direction 0.1 at a time (at most 60 steps) until it does (rr::clearCamera)
hall_b_fix.check: on all 64 frames the rule changes the camera of exactly frames 56 to 61 (and frame 62's previous camera); every other camera is byte-identical in the frame JSON
hall_b_fix.rerender: frames 56 to 61 of H:/rr-dataset-v4/val/hall_b_p7: inputs and references at hall_b's 8,192 spp; frame 62: input only; the old hard links are removed first so H:/rr-dataset is untouched

v5.model: v4 unchanged (architecture, split demodulation, continuous validity, epsilon 0.01), version 5
v5.change: one loss term: 0.1 x |mean luminance of the output - mean luminance of the reference| / (mean luminance of the reference + 0.01) over each training crop and frame (rr_train.py --energy-weight 0.1); nothing else changes
v5.training: v5main and v5shuffled (shuffled-target control), 6,000 steps each, the committed hyperparameters, on the CPU at BelowNormal with 6 threads each, the survival pattern

selection: amendment 5's rule, every loss recomputed on the new validation split (hall_b with the fix, terrain_100, cloister; frames 0 to 31) with amendment 5's loss (no energy term), by rr_select.py --recompute: candidates v4main and v5main; v1 must fail the learning check; the qualifying candidate with the lowest recomputed loss is chosen and is the only model evaluated on test

prediction.validation: v5 on cloister: tone-mapped luminance bias within 0.02 of SVGF's, and linear energy (output over reference) at or above 0.95 on every frame
prediction.test_raw_hall: if v5 is chosen: raw_hall tone-mapped bias within 0.02 of SVGF's, energy at or above 0.95 on every frame, mean FLIP at or below 0.24 (v4's no-history level); it may still not beat SVGF's 0.174
prediction.verdict: rr-bounds.json's success criteria are unchanged; the prediction is a stated expectation, not a bound

bounds: unchanged from rr-bounds.json and amendment 6 (quality, temporal, ghosting, the conditioning check at 1e-2 with its control, the shuffled and zero-motion controls)
does_not_prove: That the energy term is the right remedy if it helps; that the cloister represents raw_hall beyond the lighting character; anything on scenes not run.
